facts.text: Forest Grove sits at the crossroads of Forest Grove Road and Lower Mountain Road in Buckingham Township, Bucks County, Pennsylvania.
Early settlers named the area Forest Grove after the dense woodlands that once blanketed the hills, giving the community its enduring name.
The town’s quiet, rural atmosphere and picturesque landscapes make it a quintessential Bucks County hidden gem, according to local writers.
The Smith House Planning Historic Homes Tour invites visitors to explore well‑preserved residences that showcase architectural styles from the 19th and early 20th centuries.
Annual meetings, holiday socials, and garden tours organized by the Friends group keep the community connected while celebrating Forest Grove’s heritage.
